title: Glowing anchor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow aura behind anchor -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="34" ry="34" fill="#0a3a5c" opacity="0.45"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="26" ry="26" fill="#1060a0" opacity="0.3"/>

  <!-- Ring at top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="22" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#7dd8ff" stroke-width="4.5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="22" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#d4f4ff" stroke-width="1.8"/>

  <!-- Shank (vertical bar) -->
  <rect x="46" y="30" width="8" height="42" rx="3.5" fill="#7dd8ff"/>
  <rect x="48.5" y="31" width="3" height="40" rx="1.5" fill="#c8f0ff" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Crossbar / stock -->
  <rect x="30" y="36" width="40" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#5fc0e8"/>
  <rect x="31" y="37.5" width="38" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#a8e8ff" opacity="0.75"/>

  <!-- Left arm -->
  <path d="M34 54 C20 54, 16 68, 24 76" fill="none" stroke="#7dd8ff" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M34 54 C22 54, 19 66, 25 73" fill="none" stroke="#c8f0ff" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d="M66 54 C80 54, 84 68, 76 76" fill="none" stroke="#7dd8ff" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M66 54 C78 54, 81 66, 75 73" fill="none" stroke="#c8f0ff" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Left fluke -->
  <path d="M22 74 L12 82 L16 90 L26 83 Z" fill="#5fc0e8"/>
  <path d="M22 76 L15 82 L18 87 L25 82 Z" fill="#a8e8ff" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Right fluke -->
  <path d="M78 74 L88 82 L84 90 L74 83 Z" fill="#5fc0e8"/>
  <path d="M78 76 L85 82 L82 87 L75 82 Z" fill="#a8e8ff" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Bottom point of shank -->
  <path d="M46 72 L50 80 L54 72 Z" fill="#5fc0e8"/>

  <!-- Sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="30" r="1.8" fill="#e8f8ff" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="34" r="1.5" fill="#e8f8ff" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="16" r="1.3" fill="#c8f0ff" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="18" r="1.6" fill="#e8f8ff" opacity="0.85"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="66" r="1.4" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
